Name: JP's Director's Viewfinder - Freecam - Camera Pan
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][color=#00ff00][size=6][u][center]
Director's Viewfinder[/center][/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]Look, Mom, I'm a virtual character in a video game, and now I'm a film cameraman. They even let me play around with the filters!!![/i][/b][/size][/color]


[size=4]With this mod, you'll have access to different camera types that let you perform unique actions, such as moving the camera freely around the map, following other NPCs, having the camera follow you with a delay effect, applying color filters, and more. [/size]


[color=#00ff00][size=4][b][i]The controls used by the mod can be changed at any time using GMCM; you'll also find other useful options to enhance immersion. [/i][/b][/size][/color]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][b]Features:[/b][/size][/color]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Static black bars:[/b] Black bars that appear at the top and bottom of the screen, with two adjustment levels and a black screen. These are controlled using Control + numpad 0, 1, 2, 3.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/9QyX34SQ/adw_3_29_2026_57539488.png[/img]


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Bn2ZW8yS/adw_3_29_2026_57545210.png[/img]

[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][b]﻿[/b][size=4][b]Animated black bars:[/b] Black bars gradually appear at the top and bottom of the screen to open or close the curtain. Use the left Alt key + numpad 0, 1, 2, 3 to control this. Adjust its speed using GMCM. [/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/FKbZ8ZNF/Fadea.gif[/img]


[b][i][color=#00ff00][size=5]Camera controls: Press the F3 key (configurable) to switch to each active camera (you can also configure which camera you want to use).[/size][/color][/i][/b]

[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Bounded Panning:[/b] It allows you to move the camera within a certain range around the player. [/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/8CqSXTpY/Cam.gif[/img]

[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Cinematic:[/b] The camera doesn't stay fixed on the player; instead, it moves slightly after each movement. [/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/PrfB4CWB/Cam_1.gif[/img]

[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Drone:[/b] This camera lets you explore the area around the map; it immediately returns to the player's position. [/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/br5HkVHr/Cam_2.gif[/img]

[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]NPC Tracking:[/b] During free camera mode, select an NPC using the assigned key to have the camera start following their movements. [/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Fz6g3CgY/Cam_4.gif[/img]

[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Free Camera:[/b] Move the camera around the map however you like; it will only move if you control it. [/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/R0GtwbvF/Cam_3.gif[/img]

﻿
[list]
[*][size=3]You are free to move around in all cameras; if you go outside the viewable area, an icon will show your position off-screen (configurable). You can control the cameras by moving the cursor to the edges of the screen (configurable) or using the arrow keys. [/size]
[*][size=3]You can adjust the speed at which the camera moves. [/size]
[*][size=3]For a more immersive experience, you can also disable the mod's messages, the HUD messages that appear when you pick up an item, and the red marker that shows where a tool will strike. [/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3][b]You can also apply a color filter to the screen by pressing the right Alt key + numpad 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, or 7. You can see each one of them in the pictures.[/b][/size]
[/list]

[size=4][color=#00ff00]This mod is designed to be used with screenshot mode (F4), as the HUD will not be affected by any of the filters.[/color] There is also an option to have the filters affect dialog boxes, but that is the only thing they will change.
You can choose to use the hardware cursor, which will be visible during screenshot mode but will be hidden in screen recordings. 
[b][i]In GMCM, you can configure the keys however you like (for example, Left Control + Left Alt + Numpad); however, the system is somewhat unreliable, and if you use two similar key combinations, both may trigger their respective functions. 

[/i][/b][/size]
[color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i]I think that's it! I just wanted the fixed-camera mode and ended up with this whole system, haha. If you have any suggestions, feel free to share them; I'm sure we can get something good out of this mod. [/i][/b][/size][/color]


[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.
